caseName: National Small Shipments Traffic Conference, Inc. v. Ringsby Truck Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: NATIONAL SMALL SHIPMENTS TRAFFIC CONFERENCE, INC. v. RINGSBY TRUCK LINES, INC.
attorneys: Arthur A. Arsham, John J. C. Martin and Max L. Wymore for appellants., LeGrand Alf Carlston and Z. L. Pearson, Jr., for appellees., Solicitor General Griswold, former Solicitor General Marshall and Robert W. Ginnane for the United States et al.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed as moot.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
